title: Types Of Computers
definition: Classification of computational systems based on their data handling methods (analog, digital, hybrid), size, architecture, and processing capacity (supercomputers, mainframes, minicomputers, microcomputers).
importanceInUpsc: Directly tested in UPSC Prelims under Science and Technology (IT & Computing advancements) and relevant for Mains GS-3 applications in national supercomputing missions, artificial intelligence data processing, and digital governance architecture.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and operational mechanisms of all types of computers.
Evaluate spatial distribution of India's supercomputing infrastructure and policy frameworks.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on computer classification.
